scientific_readout: The global expansion increases independent challenges of already-frozen qualitative response states. Branching now has three system layers and same-direction propagation six, while buffering remains synthetically available but empirically unmapped. Guaiacum remains an axis-decoupling constraint and Dominica remains a protected failed prediction.
next_mainline_gate: Do not continue unconstrained archipelago searching merely to raise counts. Reopen Tier B/D systems only on named source triggers that can close a declared missing link. The highest-value unresolved mainline remains source-native empirical mechanism mapping, especially the existing five-gate network-context contract, while preserving the global state-class screen as a non-fitting external challenge set.
claim_boundary: The 54-unit screen is broad global coverage, not a literal census of every named island or publication. Strict target count is not identical to independent archipelago count, and matching a qualitative state does not identify the real-world ABM mechanism.
